name: Unifi OS Server VM
description: Unifi OS Server is the operating system that powers Ubiquiti's UniFi line of network devices. It provides a centralized platform for managing and monitoring UniFi access points, switches, and security gateways, offering features such as network configuration, device provisioning, and performance analytics.

notes.text: Defaults use Debian 13; Ubuntu 24.04 LTS is available in Advanced Settings. Cloud-Init is required. Leaving the password empty generates one; the script reports the host-side credentials file.

UniFi OS installs on first boot after Cloud-Init has finished and grown the root filesystem. The VM IP and the UniFi web interface becoming ready are separate steps. Access HTTPS on port 11443 after installation.

If installation is not ready, check journalctl -u cloud-final -u unifi-os-firstboot.service and /var/log/unifi-os-install.log inside the VM. Existing unattended VM_OS_VERSION, VM_ROOT_PASSWORD and VM_SSH_KEYS settings remain supported.
